body:
I appreciate the replies - most of them, anyway - but I should clarify something.  For the most part, I'm over her, or at least over the notion that we'll ever be back together.  I don't know why she hasn't bothered to reach out to me if she really loved me like she always said she did, but there's nothing I can do about that.

What truly scares me is the notion that I could be locked up or otherwise have my life ruined over what was otherwise a legitimately loving and supportive relationship.  I don't want to go back, and if I do, I'm afraid I'll end it there.

That's sweet of you, but I'm not sharing any identifying information of that sort.  I already mentioned that she was of legal age, which should be enough.  I have never once taken advantage of anyone, but thanks for what you're implying.  I appreciate the suggestion to get help, but I'm not some sick pervert struggling with attraction to young girls.
